anchor_set.rule: Use only the named public-preview units recorded before live responses; this is not exhaustive behavior coverage.

r01.text: Device re-enrollment in `crates/coder-access` keeps adding grants until the 128-grant bound prevents a new device from enrolling.

r02.text: Fix grant retention so a device that enrolls again has one live grant, and revoked or superseded grants do not prevent new enrollment.

r03.text: Preserve the bound for distinct live devices and preserve already-issued delegated access when its issuing device enrolls again.

r04.text: Delegation must still narrow authority and obey explicit revocation; re-enrollment must not revive authority that was revoked or removed.

r06.text: Cover the public invitation and owner-approved enrollment paths with regression tests.

r08.text: Work only on the isolated code and tests in `crates/coder-access/`; host-store cleanup, deployment, owner devices, and changes outside this package are outside this trial.
